- (2,1,1), (3,1,2), (3,2,1), (5,1,4), (5,2,2), (5,4,1), (7,2,3), (7,3,2), (7,1,6), (4,1,3), (9,2,4)...

Let me use a fixed list of triples and pick l randomly.
